name: How long does a professional kitchen faucet installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a professional kitchen faucet installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard kitchen faucet installation by a professional usually takes between one to three hours, depending on the complexity of the existing plumbing and the new faucet. Factors like needing to modify countertop holes for a new faucet type, dealing with corroded water lines, or installing additional features like sprayers or soap dispensers can extend this timeframe. Our technicians at CG Plumbing Solutions ensure a thorough installation while working efficiently to minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional kitchen faucet installation typically takes one to three hours. Complexity of existing plumbing or new features can affect the duration.
